plan: Queue support as primary. It is Willy's best role at 51.5% over 360 games (overall is 50.9%). Set midlane as secondary, not the other way around.
Stop queueing offlane: 42.1% over 159 games is costing real VP. When auto-filled there, play the safest comfort pick, not a learning pick.
Two-hero rule for the climb: Lt. Belica and Skylar. Compared with the average player on the same hero, Willy wins about 8.0 and 5.3 more games per 100 on them.
Willy's champion pool is 13+ heroes wide and the top three are only 43% of the games. Gold-to-Platinum climbs are almost always pool-narrowing stories: aim for 70%+ of games on the top three.
The math: Willy is at 665 VP; Platinum III starts at 900. The all-time peak is 903 — Platinum-level rating has been touched once already; this is a consistency problem, not a ceiling problem.
honesty: personal winrates are shrunk toward the player's own average (small heater samples do not count as mains)
field baselines are all-ranks aggregates from our current-patch match sample, not Gold-bracket-specific yet
winrate edges are observational; they say where the player wins, not why

insights.title: Willy is a closer, not a marathoner
insights.finding: Games under 28 minutes: 60%. Past 32: 45%. Press early leads and call objectives; do not let games drift.
